exceptions.reason: Local AGENTS.md prescribes unittest; native assertions retain subtest diagnostics.
exceptions.risk: An ineffective assertion could satisfy execution coverage.
exceptions.compensating_check: Behavioral assertion calibration with specific diagnostics
exceptions.review_condition: Test framework or lint policy changes

exceptions.reason: The repository's unittest runner owns exception assertions without a second framework.
exceptions.risk: An overly broad exception expectation could mask another failure.
exceptions.compensating_check: Specific exception families and diagnostic calibration
exceptions.review_condition: Test framework or lint policy changes

exceptions.reason: The checker executable is fixed; only owned fixture paths vary, without a shell.
exceptions.risk: A changed command producer could introduce untrusted execution.
exceptions.compensating_check: Coverage-gate subprocess contract and calibration tests
exceptions.review_condition: Command producer or fixture ownership changes

exceptions.reason: The CLI intentionally emits its diagnostic protocol on stdout.
exceptions.risk: A future diagnostic could disclose an unbounded or private payload.
exceptions.compensating_check: CLI tests assert precise coverage failures and valid controls

exceptions.reason: Internal callers supply executable argv without a shell; input is sent on stdin.
exceptions.risk: PATH or executable compromise is outside the process I/O boundary.
exceptions.compensating_check: Real-process deadline, byte-limit, refusal and cleanup contracts
exceptions.review_condition: Executable resolution or command producer changes
